text.tspan: app/ (Python, standard library + numpy, scipy, Pillow)
demo/: photos, saved real VTO results, final looks
recommend.py, full_look.py, brow_card.py, face_rules.py, care_rules_*.py: plans and rules
looks.py: option id to Makeup VTO body
capture_guide.js, face_auto.js, face_check.js: photo checks and landmarks (MediaPipe)
shade_preview.js, makeup_layers.js, camouflage.js, camo_editor.js: local layers (OpenCV.js)
